definitions.gloss: area studies; interdisciplinary study of a region
definitions.explanation: The interdisciplinary academic study of a particular region of the world—its language, history, politics, economy, and culture—combining several fields to understand that region as a whole. Examples include Asian studies and Middle Eastern studies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{東南|とうなん}アジア→東南アジア：16277_tounanajia⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地域研究|ちいきけんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I do area studies of Southeast Asia at university.

⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}→研究所：19075_kenkyuujo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中東|ちゅうとう}→中東：17924_chuutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地域研究|ちいきけんきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。

notes:
Formed from ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ (region, area) + ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧ (study, research). An academic field that draws on history, politics, linguistics, and anthropology together.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地域研究|ちいきけんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧: an area-studies specialist
- ⟦アジア→アジア：01763_ajia⟧{地域研究|ちいきけんきゅう}: Asian area studies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国際関係論|こくさいかんけいろん}: international relations — studies relations between states rather than one region in depth.
